transcript:
MARTIN: C'mon you're kidding, right? It doesn't really say that? 

DAVID: I'm serious... Okay, I'm coming up to a corner... Oh wait... At the end of the hall I can see... Wait...

[SFX: He walks on... ]

MARTIN: Should be the foyer?

DAVID: Yeah, I can see it through the glass in the door ahead...

MARTIN: OK, head there. That's the best way to get to the east wing. It's also the entranceway to the cells...

[SFX: door opens. A few footsteps.]

DAVID: Hey, I'm back at the foyer.
